count_scope: Six domain selections, with repeated retention cases across domains; not unique scenarios or executed cases. Two seeds and quick/confirmation are execution roles.

coverage_summary.flat_speed: Stand nine heights; continuous height; fore/aft0.5..5m/s; acceleration/braking; yaw +/-4/8rad/s and +/-1/2/3rps, spin+translation, nominal305 plus230/320/430mm.
coverage_summary.terrain: Rough,15deg slopes, material; rolling3/6/10cm; 3x4cm up/down; 5..15cm down; 15..25cm body climb and200+250mm double.
coverage_summary.recovery: 54 script->RL handoffs and perturbation/basic retention; static/low-speed follow-on; not high-speed->fall->recover->high-speed whole sequence.
coverage_summary.jump: Stationary3/6/10/15/20/25/30cm; running3/6/10cm; request repeat/cancel/stop-jump-resume; assist disabled in fixed assessment.
coverage_summary.stepjump: Manual/laser3/6/10/15/20/25cm and200+250mm double; principally305mm and fixed approach, not full height-speed joint domain.

evaluator_executed_scope: Remote CPU input preflight only; no native behavior assessment or skill qualification.
agent_review: /root/integrated_evaluator_review read-only coverage audit; root recomputed bound domain counts and six exact template derivations.
